ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patches are localized on the distal regions of both lobes, extending from the tips toward the center. The central region flanking the median notch consists of a low-intensity black core heavily populated with high-contrast white circular pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes of 5-15 pixels across the entire trailing edge; notably more jagged on the left lobe than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature along the leading edge, culminating in an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed, roughly circular high-contrast white rings (diameter 5-10 pixels) forming a complex constellation, particularly concentrated in the dark central pigmentation zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical linear disruption (white) is located on the right lobe near the median notch; multiple smaller horizontal linear scratches are visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) globally. Significant high-relief calcified accumulations (barnacles) are attached to both the far left and far right distal tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of live sessile barnacle clusters providing extreme three-dimensional texture and high-intensity white signatures at the extreme fluke tips.
